name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.schedule_selection
type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  ∀ (γ : outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.BatchSchedule q.n),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.ScheduleRealization q f τ O seed ω batch γ →
                      have callStart := (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchStartCall q O seed ω batch).getD 0;
                      (Function.Injective fun j =>
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            Option.map (fun job => job.id)
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedJob q O seed ω batch j) =
                              some (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)) ∧
                          ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j =
                              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchLabels q seed batch
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)
